name: Composio
shortDescription: Connects agents to third-party apps and tools. Docs and a $0 Hobby plan were checked; not installed here.
longDescription: Composio is a tool-use layer between agents and third-party apps. The pricing page we crawled included Hobby / $0 / no-credit-card language. We checked docs and the October 15, 2026 CLI release, and we did not install it or create an account.
pricingNotes: Confirm current Hobby limits on composio.dev/pricing.
freeTierNotes: Pricing page crawl includes Hobby/$0/no credit card language.
bestFor: Agents that need many SaaS tools without custom OAuth for each one
Teams evaluating a hosted tool layer with an open-source SDK
notIdealFor: A single API you already call directly
A local hands-on test — we did not run one
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).
